test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the length of a rectangular solar panel having an area of 110 m² is 10% more than its breadth, then what will be the breadth?
solution:
**Given**

Area of panel = 110 m²

Length of panel = breadth + 10% of breadth

**Formula used**

Area of rectangular panel = length × breadth

**Calculation**

let the breadth of rectangular solar panel is x m

so, length of rectangular solar panel = x + 10% of x

⇒ 110x/100

Area of panel = x × (110x/100)

⇒ (11x²/10) = 110

⇒ x² = (110 × 10)/11

⇒ x² = 100

⇒ x = 10m

**∴ Breadth of panel is 10 m.**
